description.templateType: A stylish documentation template built with Fumadocs.
description.about: This template provides a solid foundation for building beautiful documentation websites with Fumadocs, Next.js 16, and Tailwind CSS. It includes a modern layout, responsive navigation, MDX support, search, and sensible defaults, so you can focus on writing documentation instead of building the infrastructure.
description.audience: This template is designed for developers, open-source maintainers, SaaS teams, and anyone who needs a fast, customizable documentation site. Whether you're documenting an API, product, library, or internal project, this template gives you a production-ready starting point.
included: Responsive layout for desktop and mobile
Sidebar navigation and table of contents
